scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules && pnpm install
scripts.compile: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter agent-resume-panel run compile
scripts.install:local: pnpm run compile && pnpm --filter agent-resume-panel run package && node apps/extension/scripts/install-local.mjs
scripts.install:local-vscode: pnpm run compile && pnpm --filter agent-resume-panel run package && node apps/extension/scripts/install-local.mjs --editors=code --require-all
scripts.pack:desktop: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @agent-resume/desktop run pack:mac
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:mac-app && pnpm --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:node-pty && pnpm --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:doctor && pnpm --filter @agent-resume/desktop run test:workbench-files
